name: mehandibysana
description: Mehandi By Sana - Standalone Headless Next.js Storefront, MedusaJS v2 Backend & Migration Pipeline

scripts.migrate:sql: node -e "const p=require('path'),{execSync}=require('child_process'); const a=process.argv[1]; const target=a?JSON.stringify(p.resolve(process.cwd(),a)):''; execSync('npm --prefix migration run extract:sql'+(target?' -- '+target:''),{stdio:'inherit'});"
scripts.migrate:wp: npm --prefix migration run extract && npm --prefix migration run transform && npm --prefix migration run validate
scripts.migrate:sync: cd backend && npx medusa exec ./src/scripts/sync-migrated-data.ts && npx medusa exec ./src/scripts/import-all-orders.ts
scripts.import:prod-sql: node -e "const p=require('path'),{execSync}=require('child_process'); const raw=process.argv[1]; if(!raw){console.error('Usage: npm run import:prod-sql -- /path/to/prod-dump.sql'); process.exit(1);} const sql=p.resolve(process.cwd(),raw); execSync('npm --prefix migration run extract:sql -- '+JSON.stringify(sql), {stdio:'inherit'}); execSync('cd backend && npx medusa exec ./src/scripts/sync-migrated-data.ts && npx medusa exec ./src/scripts/import-all-orders.ts', {stdio:'inherit'});"
